digest.component_or_area: Build and CI integration — make lint and GitHub Actions wiring
propositions: The ownership-direction gate (check_config_ownership.py) and field-consumption gate (check_config_reads.py) must run on every change through a portable local make lint trigger, with CI as a mirror.

The check_config_reads.py gate currently runs only as a standalone GitHub Actions workflow step and must be moved into the make lint target to prevent double-runs and ensure portability across CI providers.
The make lint target must wire both gate invocations as its single source of truth; CI inherits gate execution through its existing make lint step, eliminating the redundant standalone workflow step.

The workflow-parity test (test_ci_workflow_parity.py) must assert that the Makefile lint target contains both gate invocations and that CI still runs make lint, so that removing either gate or the lint step from the workflow fails the parity check.
The test_ci_wires_the_gate test must be re-anchored from the workflow to the Makefile lint target to assert proper gate wiring after the standalone workflow step is removed.
